nights.title: El Tri
nights.name: El Tri
nights.extract: El Tri is a Mexican rock band from Mexico City fronted by Alex Lora. It is a spinoff of Three Souls in My Mind, formed in 1968. The group is regarded as influential in the development of Mexican rock music.

nights.title: Keenan Te
nights.name: Keenan Te
nights.extract: Keenan Te is an Australian singer-songwriter of Vietnamese and Cambodian heritage. He is known for piano-driven ballads and songs that gained popularity through TikTok.
